selectedBodyReviews.title: Usage by API key merges distinct keys for today/24h; aggregate periods serialize raw keys
selectedBodyReviews.analysis: Current usageRepo apiKeyIdentity uses persistent ID or opaque SHA256 prefix in both short-window and daily aggregation; response metadata is masked. Security agent independently confirmed. Raw private daily storage is not evidence of public leakage.

selectedBodyReviews.analysis: GitLab PAT verification uses DNS-pinned fetchPublic/fetchTrustedLocal, proxy fail-closed checks, maxRedirects0, body cancellation and sanitized public errors. Security agent confirmed existing gitlab-pat-ssrf-guard coverage.
